cigars.similarCigars: La Flor Dominicana Air Bender; J.C. Newman El Baton
cigars.about: A box-pressed Nicaraguan puro in AJ Fernandez's New World series. It is named for his Dorado farm in Estelí, which supplies most of the tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: Made at AJ Fernandez's San Lotano factory in Ocotal, not the main Estelí factory. The Criollo '98 binder comes from Holt's and Neptune; the maker only says Nicaragua. Famous Smoke calls the wrapper sun grown Criollo '98. Holt's, Neptune and Famous Smoke all list it as medium.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: CAO Consigliere; My Father Flor de Las Antillas
cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro made from aged tobacco off four of AJ Fernandez's oldest farms in Estelí. It is meant as a nod to the Cuban cigars his father smoked before the revolution.
cigars.researchNote: A small batch reached some shops in 2016; the national release was August 2019. The maker only says the wrapper is Nicaraguan; Famous Smoke calls it Nicaraguan Habano. Neptune and Holt's list it as medium, Famous Smoke as full.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Diesel Uncaged; Kristoff Corojo Maduro
cigars.about: The second cigar AJ Fernandez blended with his father Ismael, released in 2015. It is known for pairing an Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper with a Cameroon binder.
cigars.researchNote: The maker now lists this original blend as Enclave Habano and called it full-bodied at launch. Retailers differ on strength: Holt's says medium-full, Neptune says full.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Punch Gran Puro; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: An oval-pressed San Lotano blend from AJ Fernandez with a dark Ecuadorian Habano 2000 wrapper, built largely from aged tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: In 2018 the maker pulled the Oval from general distribution and said it would become a Cigars International exclusive. It is not on the maker's site now, though Holt's still sells it. Strength is Holt's listing; halfwheel's reviewer found it medium. Maduro and Connecticut versions also exist.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: My Father Le Bijou 1922; CAO Pilón
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan Rojita (hybrid of Connecticut 8212, Corojo 99 and Havana 2000)
cigars.about: A box-pressed AJ Fernandez line named after Cuba's national fine arts museum in Havana. Its wrapper is a Nicaraguan-grown hybrid leaf the company calls Rojita.
cigars.researchNote: The maker now lists it as Bellas Artes Habano and labels the Rojita wrapper Habano, though it is a hybrid seed. Holt's lists it as medium-full; Neptune's and Famous Smoke's spec tables say full, though both describe it as medium to full.

cigars.similarCigars: Baccarat Original; EP Carrillo New Wave Connecticut
cigars.about: An inexpensive everyday Fuente lonsdale made with medium-length Dominican filler instead of long filler. It comes in one size, 6 1/2 x 43.
cigars.researchNote: Wrapper is disputed: Fuente's site says Connecticut Shade, while Neptune and Famous Smoke list Cameroon. Strength is split too: Holt's and Famous Smoke say medium, Neptune says mild. A Curly Head Deluxe in the same size is sold alongside it, in natural or maduro.

cigars.similarCigars: Padron 3000; Rocky Patel Sun Grown
cigars.about: Fuente's cedar-wrapped series. The natural version pairs a Connecticut Shade wrapper with Dominican binder and filler.
cigars.researchNote: Sizes listed are the natural wrapper ones; Sun Grown and Maduro versions also exist. Cigar Aficionado and Neptune say the Connecticut Shade is U.S. grown; Famous Smoke says Ecuadorian. Cigar Aficionado and Neptune rate it mild; Holt's and Famous Smoke say medium.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Red Dot; Punch Rare Corojo
cigars.about: The smallest perfecto in Fuente's Hemingway series, a 4 x 49 with a Cameroon wrapper over Dominican binder and filler.
cigars.researchNote: This is one size of the Hemingway line, which debuted in 1983. A Maduro version with a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper is also made.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; AVO Improvisation
cigars.about: A 6 x 47 cigar in Fuente's Gran Reserva series and one of the brand's best known everyday smokes. The standard natural version has a Cameroon wrapper over Dominican tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: One size of the Gran Reserva line. Specs here are the natural; it is also made in Maduro (Connecticut Broadleaf), Sun Grown (Ecuador), Rosado Sun Grown and Candela. Neptune rates it mild; Famous Smoke and Holt's say medium.

cigars.similarCigars: AVO Domaine; Perdomo 20th Anniversary
cigars.about: Named for Carlos Fuente Sr. and made with Dominican tobaccos aged as long as ten years under an African Cameroon wrapper.
cigars.researchNote: Cigar Aficionado says the first Don Carlos was sold in 1976 and made in Esteli, Nicaragua; halfwheel counted 2015 as the brand's 30th year. Holt's rates it medium-full, Neptune full, and Cigar Aficionado rated the Presidente medium. Sizes follow Fuente's site; Holt's lists a few slightly longer.

cigars.similarCigars: Ashton VSG; La Flor Dominicana Andalusian Bull
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Dominican Corojo-seed, grown at Chateau de la Fuente
cigars.about: Fuente's best-known high-end line, an all-Dominican cigar built around wrapper leaf grown on the family's Chateau de la Fuente farm. It debuted in late 1995 and is still hard to find.
cigars.researchNote: Cigar Aficionado has rated it full (Reserva D'Chateau) and medium-full (Double Robusto); Neptune lists full. Cigar Aficionado describes the wrapper as Corojo seed grown under shade cloth, while halfwheel calls it sun grown. Fuente also makes a Shark, Petite Lancero, Double Corona and an A size.

cigars.similarCigars: AVO Classic; Cohiba Macassar
cigars.about: The original Ashton blend, made for Ashton by the Fuente family in the Dominican Republic. It pairs a golden Connecticut Shade wrapper with Dominican binder and filler aged three to four years and is the brand's mildest core line.
cigars.researchNote: Ashton's own site simply calls this line Ashton; Classic is the common shop name. The maker lists 13 sizes, also including Monarch (6 x 50), Crystal No. 1 (6.5 x 44) and Sovereign (6.75 x 55).

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Macassar; Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged
cigars.about: A longer-aged step up from the core Ashton blend, made by the Fuente family. Dominican tobaccos aged five to seven years sit under a Connecticut Shade wrapper, and several sizes are perfectos and figurados.
cigars.researchNote: The maker also lists a No. 1 at 9 x 52.

cigars.similarCigars: La Aroma De Cuba Original; Macanudo Inspirado Black
cigars.about: Ashton's maduro line, made by the Fuente family with a slow-fermented Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over aged Dominican tobaccos. It is a sweet, mellow maduro rather than a strong one.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Black; Perdomo Lot 23
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Dominican sun grown from Chateau de la Fuente
cigars.about: Ashton's top-priced line, an all-Dominican cigar made by the Fuente family with a wrapper from their Chateau de la Fuente farm. It was created for Ashton's 20th anniversary, and each size is named as a yearly salute.
cigars.researchNote: ESG stands for Estate Sun Grown. The wrapper comes from the same Fuente farm that grows Fuente Fuente OpusX wrapper. Made in small batches, so supply can be tight.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; La Flor Dominicana Andalusian Bull
cigars.about: Ashton's full-bodied line, made by the Fuente family since 1999. A dark Sumatra-seed wrapper grown on a private estate in Ecuador covers Dominican binder and filler aged four to five years.
cigars.researchNote: VSG stands for Virgin Sun Grown. Most sizes are box-pressed. The maker also lists Enchantment (4.375 x 60) and Illusion (6.5 x 44).

cigars.similarCigars: Ashton Classic; Cohiba Connecticut
cigars.about: The original AVO blend, created by jazz pianist Avo Uvezian with Hendrik Kelner and now made by Davidoff in the Dominican Republic. It is a mellow, creamy cigar with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Dominican tobaccos.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's and Famous list it mild to medium, Neptune lists it mild. Neptune names the binder as Dominican Olor and the filler as Piloto Cubano. The No. 5 length varies by source: Holt's and Famous say 6 7/8 inches, halfwheel 6 3/4 and Neptune 6 5/8.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; Arturo Fuente 8-5-8
cigars.about: AVO's series of annual limited editions, usually released in March around Avo Uvezian's birthday. It followed the older AVO LE releases, and every year was a different blend and size made by Davidoff in the Dominican Republic.
cigars.researchNote: This is a series, not one blend, so there is no single wrapper or strength. It began in 2015 with the Classic Covers releases, used the Improvisation name from LE17 through LE21, and closed in 2022 with the LE22 White and Black. Ask which year a given box is.

cigars.similarCigars: Padron 2000; Rocky Patel Sun Grown
cigars.about: Introduced at the 2010 IPCPR show and billed as the strongest AVO to that point, at a lower price than the rest of the range. A sun grown Ecuadorian wrapper covers Dominican and Peruvian tobaccos, made by Davidoff.
cigars.researchNote: Strength listings vary: Neptune medium, Holt's medium-full, Famous full. Halfwheel calls the wrapper Ecuadorian sun grown, while Holt's and Famous call it Ecuador Habano.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo 20th Anniversary; Arturo Fuente Don Carlos
cigars.about: A richer AVO made by Davidoff that used tobacco from Avo Uvezian's own Dominican farm, Domaine AVO, under a sun grown Ecuadorian wrapper. Its shapes included perfectos.
cigars.researchNote: Neptune reports the line as discontinued and other retailers show it sold out. Strength descriptions range from medium to full. One retailer calls the wrapper Ecuadorian Connecticut sun grown. A No. 70 toro was also listed, size not confirmed.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente Curly Head; CAO Gold
cigars.about: The core Baccarat cigar, a mild and inexpensive Honduran smoke made by Davidoff's Camacho operation. It is best known for its sweetened cap.
cigars.researchNote: This is the core line, sold as Baccarat or Baccarat The Game. The cap is sweetened. Most sources give a Mexican binder, but some retailer spec tables say Honduran. There are 13 sizes in all.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary; Rocky Patel Vintage 1999
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Hybrid Connecticut Shade and Brazilian Arapiraca (Mata Fina), grown in Ecuador
cigars.about: One of the three lines Caldwell launched with in 2014, and the mildest of them. It uses a hybrid Connecticut Shade wrapper grown in Ecuador over Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: Caldwell calls the wrapper a proprietary hybrid of Connecticut Shade and Brazilian Arapiraca; Neptune and halfwheel list it simply as Ecuadorian Connecticut. Caldwell rates it 2 of 5 for strength, while Neptune calls it Medium.

cigars.filler: Dominican Republic (Ligero), Nicaragua (Habano), Peru (Pelo de Oro)
cigars.otherWrapperVersions: Maduro (Mexican San Andrés); Crowning size uses Dominican Corojo
cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; CAO Brazilia
cigars.about: The fullest of Caldwell's three original 2014 lines, built around a Dominican Corojo wrapper over Dominican, Nicaraguan and Peruvian filler. It later spawned the Mad MoFo and Savages offshoots.
cigars.researchNote: Caldwell rates it 4 of 5 for strength and describes it as full flavored with medium-plus body. Neptune and Atlantic both list it as Full.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; CAO Brazilia
cigars.about: Caldwell's sister brand, started in 2014 by Robert Caldwell, Tony Bellatto and Jaclyn Sears under the name Impromptu. It began by buying aged cigars found in factories and selling them in small rebranded batches, and now commissions its own blends.
cigars.researchNote: This is a brand, not one cigar: every release is a different blend, factory and strength, so there is no single spec. The current always-available lineup is 15 Minutes of Fame, Just The Tip, One Night Stand and Pepper Cream Soda. Most older drops were one-time batches.

cigars.similarCigars: Baccarat Original; Macanudo Café
cigars.about: A mellow Connecticut-wrapped cigar over Nicaraguan binder and filler, introduced in 1996. It is one of the blends that built the CAO name.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's rates it medium; the maker says mellow to medium.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Dias de Gloria; Arturo Fuente 8-5-8
cigars.about: The former CAO Sopranos Edition blend, brought back under a new name after the TV licensing deal ended. It uses a Brazilian wrapper over tobaccos from four other countries.
cigars.researchNote: This is the CAO Sopranos Edition (2005) renamed. It returned as Consigliere in late 2016 with the same blend.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Dias de Gloria; Diesel Unholy Cocktail
cigars.about: A dark Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler, sold mostly in large ring gauges. CAO credits it with bringing Brazilian wrapper leaf to wide attention.
cigars.researchNote: Country left blank because sources split: Cigar Aficionado (2017), Holt's and Neptune say Honduras, Famous Smoke lists Nicaragua. Check the box before quoting it. The maker calls it medium-full; Cigar Aficionado and Holt's call it medium.

cigars.similarCigars: La Gloria Cubana Medio Tiempo; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: Built around Bragança, a Brazilian tobacco grown in the Amazon rainforest and harvested once every three years. It wears a twisted rope of tobacco instead of a paper band.
cigars.researchNote: Not a year-round line. It ships in batches, with new runs in early 2024, 2025 and 2026, and sells out between them.

cigars.similarCigars: Dunbarton Mi Querida; Kristoff Ligero Maduro
cigars.about: A sharply box-pressed cigar with a flat cap, themed on hot rods with sizes named for engine parts. It has a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over a blend heavy on Nicaraguan leaf.
cigars.researchNote: This is the original Flathead. Steel Horse, Speed Shop and the V19, V21 and V23 editions are separate blends.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; Punch Gran Puro
cigars.about: Named for the pilón, the stack in which tobacco ferments. Its leaf was fermented in small round piles, a 19th century Cuban method that takes longer than modern fermentation.
cigars.researchNote: The Corona size (5.5 x 44) was discontinued in August 2025. Pilón Añejo is a different blend.

cigars.about: The maduro member of Christian Eiroa's C.L.E. core line, introduced at the 2025 PCA trade show. It puts a dark Mexican San Andrés wrapper over the same Honduran binder and filler used in the Connecticut, Corojo and Habano.
cigars.researchNote: Strength is disputed: the company says medium (used here), Cigar Coop mild-medium to medium, but Cigar Aficionado's rating page lists the 50x5 as Full. Filler too: Cigar Aficionado's launch article and halfwheel say Honduran; its rating page says Colombia and Honduras and Cigar Coop Colombian. Not the older Eiroa CBT Maduro.

cigars.filler: Brazil (Mata Fina), Dominican Republic (Olor, Piloto Cubano), Nicaragua (Jalapa)
cigars.similarCigars: EP Carrillo New Wave Connecticut; Macanudo Gold Label
cigars.about: The first General Cigar Cohiba with a Connecticut Shade wrapper, launched in 2019. It is made in the Dominican Republic with a wrapper grown in Ecuador.
cigars.researchNote: This is the non-Cuban Cohiba sold in the US by General Cigar. Retailers split on strength: Famous Smoke says medium, Neptune says mild; the maker rates the body medium. Halfwheel listed the Robusto at 52 ring at launch, the maker now lists 50.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente Hemingway Short Story; Diesel Whiskey Row
cigars.about: The original non-Cuban Cohiba from General Cigar, nicknamed Red Dot for the red dot inside the O on the band. It pairs a Cameroon wrapper with Dominican filler and is the core line of the US Cohiba brand.
cigars.researchNote: Not the Cuban Cohiba: this is General Cigar's Dominican-made brand, sold only in the US. The maker describes it as full in flavor but medium in strength. A 6 x 60 Gigante has also been offered.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged; Ashton Cabinet Selection
cigars.about: A high-priced Cohiba from General Cigar whose filler tobaccos were aged at least four years, finishing in Dominican rum barrels. It is named for the Macassar ebony used on its box.
cigars.researchNote: Halfwheel reported the line discontinued in March 2025, though the maker's site still shows it. Sizes are as launched; cohiba.com now lists the Toro Grande at 6 x 54 and the Double Corona at 7 1/2 x 54. The maker rates it medium-full, but halfwheel's reviewer found the strength mild to medium.

cigars.similarCigars: Foundation The Tabernacle; Ashton ESG
cigars.about: The maduro line in General Cigar's Cohiba range, with a dark Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over Dominican and Mexican tobaccos aged at least three years.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's and Neptune list it as medium, Famous Smoke as medium-full; the maker rates the body medium-full.

cigars.binder: Mexico (San Andrés, aged in Rabbit Hole bourbon barrels)
cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; Cohiba Red Dot
cigars.about: A Diesel line made by AJ Fernandez with Rabbit Hole Distilling of Louisville. Its Mexican San Andrés binder is aged in barrels that held Rabbit Hole bourbon.
cigars.researchNote: The maker rates it medium-full; Neptune lists it as medium.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Dunbarton Mi Querida; Cohiba Black
cigars.about: The belicoso from the original Diesel line, blended by AJ Fernandez in Estelí, Nicaragua. It has a Pennsylvania Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler.
cigars.researchNote: Unholy Cocktail is the 5 x 56 belicoso size of the original Diesel line, which also has a Robusto and the Shorty. The maker and Holt's rate it medium-full; Famous Smoke lists it as full.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; Matilde Renacer
cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro added to the Diesel lineup in August 2026, made by AJ Fernandez with a Habano Criollo wrapper. It sells for about 6 to 7 dollars a cigar.
cigars.researchNote: The maker rates it medium-full; Neptune lists it as full and gives the Robusto as 5 x 52 instead of 5.5 x 52.

cigars.similarCigars: Foundation Wise Man Maduro; AJ Fernandez Enclave
cigars.about: A series of small-batch one-size blends from Steve Saka, each sold in individual cedar coffins in boxes of seven. Every release is its own blend, so there is no single Muestra de Saka recipe.
cigars.researchNote: Each release is its own blend with its own wrapper and strength (maker rates them 4 to 9 out of 10), so ask which one the guest has. Exclusivo, #NLMTHA, The Bewitched and Krakatoa wear Ecuador Habano; Nacatamale is Nicaraguan sungrown and Unstolen Valor is Habano 2000 sungrown. Halfwheel lists The Bewitched at 50 ring, the maker at 48.

cigars.binder: Mexico (San Andrés Negro, Matacapan Negro de Temporal)
cigars.filler: Nicaragua (Condega, Pueblo Nuevo, Estelí), USA (Pennsylvania Broadleaf ligero)
cigars.factory: Fábrica de Tabacos Joya de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: CAO Pilón; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: The first cigar Steve Saka released under Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust, made at Joya de Nicaragua with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over a Mexican binder. It is a creamy, medium-strength blend named for the time spent lingering at the table after a meal.
cigars.researchNote: The original Sobremesa was renamed Sobremesa Solita in late 2023; the blend did not change. Maker rates strength 5 out of 10. Solita Red (6 1/4 x 46) is a slightly stronger version aged a year.

cigars.similarCigars: Kristoff Ligero Maduro; La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero
cigars.about: Steve Saka's Connecticut Broadleaf maduro, rolled at the NACSA factory in Estelí over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It was Dunbarton's second line and is known as an earthy, full-bodied broadleaf cigar at a moderate price.
cigars.researchNote: Maker rates strength 7 out of 10 and calls it full bodied; Neptune lists it as full. The name is Nicaraguan slang for a secret mistress.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Connecticut; Macanudo Gold Label
cigars.about: The milder, Connecticut-wrapped cigar in the E.P. Carrillo lineup, made at Ernesto Perez-Carrillo's factory in Santiago. It has been in production since 2011 and is the only line still listed under Classics on the maker's site.
cigars.researchNote: The maker lists Nicaraguan filler only; halfwheel lists Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. The original 7 x 49 Gran Via size is no longer listed.

cigars.similarCigars: Matilde Renacer; Perdomo 20th Anniversary
cigars.about: A box-pressed cigar made entirely of Nicaraguan tobacco but rolled at Ernesto Perez-Carrillo's factory in the Dominican Republic. It is part of the Perez-Carrillo Series and its four sizes are named for his grandchildren.
cigars.researchNote: The Majestic was Cigar Aficionado's No. 1 Cigar of 2018 and the Celestial was No. 3 in 2024. First shown in 2016 but it did not ship until March 2018. The type of Nicaraguan wrapper leaf is not published.

cigars.similarCigars: Dunbarton Sobremesa; J.C. Newman Diamond Crown
cigars.about: A full-strength cigar in the Perez-Carrillo Series that pairs a Havana-seed wrapper grown in Connecticut with an Ecuadorian binder and Nicaraguan filler. It launched in 2020 and its Prequel size was Cigar Aficionado's Cigar of the Year that year.
cigars.researchNote: The Prequel was Cigar Aficionado's No. 1 Cigar of 2020 with 98 points. The Apogee was added in 2021 as a 3,000-box limited size and is now listed by the maker with the other two.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Decade; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: A series of very thick cigars from Ernesto Perez-Carrillo, built around ring gauges of 60 and up, close to an inch across. It debuted in 2012 and is sold in Natural, Maduro and Nicaragua versions.
cigars.researchNote: INCH is a series, not one blend: Natural has an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper (medium), Maduro a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper (medium-full). INCH Nicaragua is a Nicaraguan puro (medium-full) made by Plasencia in Esteli, Nicaragua, and comes in three sizes, with no No. 70.

cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro with a Habano wrapper, named for the goat-sucker of folklore and one of Esteban Carreras's best sellers. It is rolled at the company's own factory in Esteli.
cigars.researchNote: Also written Chupa Cabra. Halfwheel dates the debut to 2012, but the 10 Year Anniversary edition of 2021 points to about 2010, so the launch year is left blank. Strength comes from one retailer (Neptune lists medium). Neptune lists slightly different size dimensions than the maker.

cigars.about: The maduro version of Chupacabra, a Nicaraguan puro with a dark, oily Nicaraguan maduro wrapper. It is rolled at Esteban Carreras's factory in Esteli.
cigars.researchNote: Strength comes from one retailer (Neptune lists full); the maker does not publish one. Neptune lists slightly different size dimensions than the maker.

cigars.about: An anniversary edition marking a decade of the Chupacabra line, introduced at the 2021 PCA trade show. It swaps in a Mexican San Andres wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler and shipped with 18 months of age.
cigars.researchNote: The maker lists it as Chupacabra 10yr. No strength or tasting notes were found from the maker or a trusted source. Do not confuse it with the separate Esteban Carreras 10 Year line, which also has a San Andres wrapper.

cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro built around a corojo seed that the factory manager, a former Cuban agriculture ministry worker, is said to have helped smuggle out of Cuba in the early 1990s. It is made at Esteban Carreras's factory in Esteli.
cigars.researchNote: Launched in 2022 as Taken From The Devil's Hand and renamed in 2024 after a trademark dispute with Warped. The maker's site lists it as Dictator's Hand Corojo. This entry is the original Corojo; a Maduro version with an Ecuadorian Corojo maduro wrapper was added in 2023.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Caldwell Eastern Standard; Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary
cigars.about: Nicholas Melillo's value-priced tribute to his home state of Connecticut, made for Foundation at AJ Fernandez in Nicaragua. This is the Connecticut Shade version, the mildest of the Charter Oak blends.
cigars.researchNote: Charter Oak comes in three wrappers: CT Shade, CT Broadleaf (Maduro) and Habano. This entry is the Shade. Wrapper origin is disputed: Foundation ties it to the Connecticut River Valley and Neptune lists U.S. Connecticut Shade, but halfwheel's 2016 trade show report lists Ecuadorian Connecticut.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Ashton Cabinet Selection; Cohiba Macassar
cigars.about: Foundation's tribute to the Olmec civilization of the San Andrés region of Mexico, made at AJ Fernandez with a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over Nicaraguan tobacco. The Claro uses the lighter wrapper and is the gentler of the two Olmec blends.
cigars.researchNote: Foundation rates Olmec Full without separating the two versions. Halfwheel's review found the Claro closer to medium-full in strength and calls the Maduro the stronger one. Halfwheel lists the Double Corona as 7 x 52, the maker as 7 x 54.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Black; Diesel Unholy Cocktail
cigars.about: Foundation's premium Connecticut Broadleaf cigar, blended by Nicholas Melillo and made at AJ Fernandez in Estelí. It is named for the sanctuary that held the Ark of the Covenant, and the box art shows Ethiopian emperor Haile Selassie.
cigars.researchNote: This is the original Broadleaf Tabernacle; the Havana Seed CT No. 142 is a separate blend. Halfwheel listed the Torpedo at 4 1/4 inches at launch, the maker now lists 4 1/2.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Vintage 1990; Cohiba Black
cigars.about: Foundation's San Andrés-wrapped companion to its Nicaraguan Wise Man blend. It first came out in 2017 and was reblended in 2024, when production moved to the Garcia family's My Father factory.
cigars.researchNote: Two versions exist. The 2017 original was made at TABSA (Aganorsa) and was discontinued in 2024; the current one is a new blend from My Father. The Lancero uses a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper instead of San Andrés.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; La Flor Dominicana Air Bender
cigars.about: A full-strength Nicaraguan cigar from J.C. Newman, rolled at the company's PENSA factory in Esteli. It revives a nickel cigar brand the founder first made in Cleveland in 1914.
cigars.researchNote: Original brand dates to 1914; brought back in 2008 and reblended bolder with new packaging in 2022. Sources disagree on the wrapper: the maker lists Ecuadorian Havana, halfwheel calls the cigar a Nicaraguan puro, and Famous Smoke lists a Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; Diesel Whiskey Row
cigars.about: J.C. Newman's main Nicaraguan line, a medium-strength cigar with a Havana-seed wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It is sold as an affordable everyday cigar.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls this original blend Brick House Classic. The name dates to 1937; J.C. Newman brought it back as a Nicaraguan cigar in 2009. Some retailers call it a Nicaraguan puro, but the maker and Cigar Aficionado say the wrapper is grown in Ecuador.

cigars.filler: Five filler tobaccos from the Caribbean and Central America (countries not itemized)
cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Fusion; Ashton Cabinet Selection
cigars.about: J.C. Newman's flagship premium line, made for the company by Arturo Fuente in the Dominican Republic. It launched in 1995 for the company's 100th anniversary and is known for its thick 54 ring sizes.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls this blend Diamond Crown Classic; a Maduro version uses a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper and is rated Medium. Maker rates the Classic Mild, while Neptune lists Medium and Famous Smoke calls it medium-bodied. Neptune lists the filler as Dominican. The No. 6 is a figurado listed at 64 ring at its widest.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; Arturo Fuente 8-5-8
cigars.about: Kristoff's core Criollo wrapped blend, sold as Original Criollo and rolled in the Dominican Republic. It has the brand's pigtail cap and uncut foot.
cigars.researchNote: Kristoff calls this line Original Criollo. Kristoff and Neptune list a Honduran Criollo wrapper, while Holt's describes it as Nicaraguan. Kristoff scores strength 3 out of 5 (medium) and Neptune agrees; Holt's and Famous say medium-full.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; Diesel Unholy Cocktail
cigars.researchNote: No Kristoff line called Corojo Maduro could be confirmed, and Kristoff's own product list does not have one. Kristoff's Corojo cigar is the Corojo Limitada (Nicaraguan Corojo Habano wrapper). Its maduro lines are Original Maduro, Ligero Maduro and Kristania Maduro, all with Brazilian wrappers.

cigars.similarCigars: Dunbarton Mi Querida; CAO Flathead
cigars.about: A stronger version of Kristoff's Original Maduro, made with more ligero leaf in the filler under a dark Brazilian wrapper. Rolled in the Dominican Republic with a pigtail cap and shaggy foot.
cigars.researchNote: Kristoff scores strength 4 out of 5; Neptune and Holt's call it full. Kristoff lists Dominican and Honduran filler, while Neptune, Holt's and Famous list Dominican and Nicaraguan. Famous names the wrapper Brazilian Arapiraca.

cigars.similarCigars: Macanudo Inspirado Black; Rocky Patel Vintage 1990
cigars.about: The core La Aroma de Cuba blend from Ashton, a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It has been made by the Garcia family at My Father Cigars in Esteli since 2008.
cigars.researchNote: Sold simply as La Aroma de Cuba. Ashton's first modern version was made at Flor de Copan in Honduras; halfwheel dates it to 2002 in one article and 2003 in another. The maker rates the current blend medium, while Neptune lists it as full.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; Caldwell Long Live the King
cigars.about: A San Andrés wrapped La Aroma de Cuba introduced in 2010 and made by the Garcia family with Nicaraguan binder and filler. It was Cigar Aficionado's number 2 cigar of 2011.
cigars.researchNote: The maker rates it medium-full; Neptune's spec table says medium.

cigars.similarCigars: La Gloria Cubana Medio Tiempo; Matilde Renacer
cigars.about: A La Aroma de Cuba line with a San Andrés Oscuro wrapper over Nicaraguan tobacco grown in the Esteli, Jalapa and Namanji regions. It returned in 2024 as a regular production line with a new blend.
cigars.researchNote: Noblesse began in 2014 as a yearly limited edition with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. The current San Andrés Oscuro blend started shipping in June 2024 and is a different cigar.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez New World Dorado; J.C. Newman El Baton
cigars.about: A strong Dominican cigar from Litto Gomez with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over binder and filler grown on the company's own farm in La Canela. It started as an event-only cigar and became a regular line in 2010.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it full bodied, while Holt's lists it as medium-full. A separate Air Bender Maduro also exists and became regular production in 2015.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Edge; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: The darker-wrapped version of La Flor Dominicana's Ligero line, with a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra leaf over Dominican tobacco from the company's farm. It is a full-strength cigar sold in the same L-numbered sizes as the regular Ligero.
cigars.researchNote: Sold as Ligero Cabinet Oscuro or Ligero Oscuro. It is the dark-wrapper version of the regular Ligero line rather than a separate blend family. The maker's site only describes the regular Ligero.

cigars.similarCigars: Padron Family Reserve; Dunbarton Mi Querida
cigars.about: La Flor Dominicana's best known power cigar, built around extra ligero leaf from the company's Dominican farm under a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper. It is the line that carries Litto Gomez's wedge-headed Chisel shape.
cigars.researchNote: Every size is also sold in a Maduro version; the wrapper given here is for the Natural. Halfwheel's 2012 review of the A size listed the wrapper as Ecuadorian Habano, while the maker says Ecuadorian Sumatra.

cigars.similarCigars: Ashton VSG; AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval
cigars.about: A single large perfecto from La Flor Dominicana, made in a shape copied from an old mold Litto Gomez found in southern Spain and named for Spain's bullfighters. It was Cigar Aficionado's number one cigar of 2016.
cigars.researchNote: One size only: a 6 1/2 inch perfecto that swells from 52 to 64 ring. The maker calls it full bodied; Holt's lists medium-full. It is made on an ongoing basis but in small quantities. A limited 10th Anniversary Maduro with a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper shipped in October 2026.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente 8-5-8; Rocky Patel Vintage 1999
cigars.about: The original blend of the non-Cuban La Gloria Cubana, the brand the Perez-Carrillo family built in Miami and later sold to General Cigar. It is a medium-bodied Dominican cigar in an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, now sold by Forged Cigar Co.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls this line Classic; it is the brand's original cigar. 1972 is when the non-Cuban brand began, not a date for the current blend. A Connecticut Broadleaf maduro version is sold as Classic Maduro. Famous Smoke lists it as medium to full.

cigars.filler: USA (Connecticut Habano medio tiempo), Dominican Republic (Piloto Cubano), Nicaragua (Esteli), Honduras (La Entrada)
cigars.similarCigars: CAO Amazon Basin; La Aroma De Cuba Noblesse
cigars.about: A value-priced La Gloria Cubana built around medio tiempo, the small, strong leaves that grow at the very top of some tobacco plants. Here that leaf is a Connecticut-grown habano used in the filler.
cigars.researchNote: The maker lists the Churchill at 7 1/4 x 54; halfwheel's launch story printed 7 1/2 x 54.

cigars.similarCigars: CAO Pilón; Dunbarton Sobremesa
cigars.about: La Gloria Cubana's big ring gauge line, known for thick sizes and a fuller, spicier take on the brand's Dominican and Nicaraguan blend. It is one of the cigars credited with starting the large ring gauge trend.
cigars.researchNote: Most sizes also come in a Connecticut Broadleaf maduro. Serie R Esteli and Serie R Black are separate blends. The maker calls it medium to full; Famous Smoke calls it full-bodied.

cigars.similarCigars: Montecristo White Label; CAO Gold
cigars.about: The original Macanudo blend and one of the best-selling premium cigars in the United States, made by General Cigar. It is a mellow Connecticut Shade cigar often suggested to new smokers.
cigars.researchNote: The maker lists 21 sizes; ten common ones are shown here. Macanudo was once made in Jamaica and is now rolled in the Dominican Republic.

cigars.binder: Mexico (San Andrés, first and second primings)
cigars.similarCigars: Montecristo White Label; Cohiba Connecticut
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Connecticut Shade "Capa Especial" (first and second primings)
cigars.about: A seasonal Macanudo that uses golden Connecticut Shade wrapper from the lowest primings of the plant, which the maker says gives extra natural sweetness. It first appeared in 2002 and comes back once a year.
cigars.researchNote: Released once a year in a limited run, so it can be out of stock between releases. The size list changes a little each year; the sizes here are the 2026 release.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Connecticut; EP Carrillo New Wave Connecticut
cigars.about: The lighter of two Inspirado blends Macanudo launched in the U.S. in 2017. It has an aged Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper and no Dominican tobacco in the blend.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it mellow to medium; Famous Smoke lists it as Medium. The maker names Esteli for part of the Nicaraguan filler, while halfwheel and Cigar Dojo say Condega. Halfwheel reported the Corona size is rolled at STG Danli in Honduras.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Vintage 1990; La Aroma De Cuba Original
cigars.about: The darker partner to Inspirado White, launched in the U.S. in 2017 with a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan filler. It was pitched as a bolder cigar than the classic Macanudo lines.
cigars.researchNote: A different cigar also called Inspirado Black, with a Connecticut Habano wrapper, was sold in Europe from 2015. Sizes are from the maker; halfwheel's 2017 list had the Robusto at 4 7/8 x 48 and the Toro at 5 7/8 x 54.

cigars.binder: USA (Connecticut Broadleaf, aged in Cabernet barrels)
cigars.filler: Brazil (Mata Fina), Dominican Republic (Olor, Piloto Cubano), Nicaragua (Jalapa)
cigars.similarCigars: Ashton Cabinet Selection; Cohiba Macassar
cigars.about: A limited Macanudo series made with Flint Knoll Winery of Napa Valley. The Broadleaf binder is aged in French oak barrels that held the winery's Cabernet Sauvignon.
cigars.researchNote: The current Estate Reserve is three limited releases with Flint Knoll: No. 1 (2022), No. 2 (2023) and No. 3 (2024), all the same basic blend. Earlier, unrelated limited editions also used the Estate Reserve name around 2014 and 2015.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; La Aroma De Cuba Noblesse
cigars.about: The first line from Matilde, the company Jose Seijas started with his sons after retiring from Altadis. Renacer means rebirth, and it is a Dominican-made Ecuadorian Habano blend.
cigars.researchNote: First made at Tabacalera Matilde in La Romana; production moved to Tabacalera Palma in December 2015. A 7 x 40 Lancero has also been made in limited quantities.

No line name was given, and Micallef does not sell a cigar called just Micallef. The brand's lines include the Color Series (Black, Blue, Red, Green, White, Purple), Micallef A, Reata, Migdalia, Leyenda, Herencia and Connecticut.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Vintage 1999; Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged
cigars.about: The Classic Series is the Dominican-made Montecristo in a U.S. Connecticut Shade wrapper over Dominican binder and filler, made by Altadis U.S.A. It sits at the smooth, creamy end of the non-Cuban Montecristo range.
cigars.researchNote: Retailers disagree on strength: Holt's lists it as mild, Famous as mild-medium, Neptune as medium. The maker calls it smooth and gives no strength word.

cigars.similarCigars: Macanudo Gold Label; Cohiba Connecticut
cigars.about: The White Series is a Dominican-made Montecristo with an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper, a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers. It is one of the brand's best-known core lines and is known for a creamy profile.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it the White Series; White Label is a retailer name for the same cigar. Strength listings vary: Holt's and Mike's say medium, Famous mild-medium, Neptune mild.

cigars.similarCigars: Ashton Cabinet Selection; AVO Heritage
cigars.about: The Platinum Series is a Dominican-made Montecristo with a Mexican San Andrés Cubano wrapper over a Dominican binder and Dominican, Nicaraguan and Peruvian fillers. It is the richer, stronger option among the brand's long-running core lines.
cigars.researchNote: Neptune lists a Nicaraguan binder; the maker says Dominican. The 2002 launch year comes from a retailer (Mike's Cigars), not the maker.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente Opus X; Ashton ESG
cigars.about: Epic is a Dominican-made Montecristo blended by Altadis U.S.A.'s Grupo de Maestros with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper and aged Nicaraguan and Dominican tobaccos. The maker describes it as fuller-bodied than its other Montecristos.
cigars.researchNote: Launched in 2012 as Epic Premium Selection '07, built on 2007 vintage tobaccos. Neptune and Mike's list it as full, but Holt's and halfwheel's review call it medium. Epic Craft Cured and Epic Vintage 12 are separate blends.

cigars.filler: Nicaragua (Habano Jalapa seco, Habano Ometepe viso, Habano Condega ligero, 2008 vintage)
cigars.similarCigars: La Aroma De Cuba Noblesse; AJ Fernandez Enclave
cigars.about: Espada is a Nicaraguan puro made for Montecristo by the Plasencia family using vintage-dated Habano tobaccos, mostly from Jalapa. It was the first Montecristo made entirely from Nicaraguan tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: Strength varies by source: Mike's says medium to full, Neptune medium, and the maker bills it as bold and spicy. Espada Oscuro, Signature and Conquistador are separate blends. Size names come from sword parts.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo 20th Anniversary; Arturo Fuente Don Carlos
cigars.about: The 1935 Anniversary Nicaragua is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro made by AJ Fernandez for Altadis U.S.A. to mark the Montecristo brand's 85th anniversary. It was blended with Rafael Nodal and the Grupo de Maestros as a tribute to the original 1935 Montecristo.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's and Mike's list it as medium-full; Neptune lists it as full. The wrapper varietal is not published. The 1935 Anniversary Edicion Diamante is a separate blend, and Cuba's Linea 1935 is unrelated.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Dias de Gloria; Diesel Whiskey Row
cigars.about: A box-pressed Nicaraguan puro from the Garcia family, named for Cuba and dressed in early 1900s label art. It was Cigar Aficionado's number one cigar of 2012.
cigars.researchNote: Sold under its own name, made by My Father Cigars. The maker rates it 3/4 to full and Holt's lists medium-full, but halfwheel's reviewer found it closer to medium.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Enclave; Diesel Uncaged
cigars.about: The Garcia family's follow-up to Flor de las Antillas, reviving an old Cuban brand name and its artwork. All five sizes are box-pressed, with filler from three Garcia farms aged at least three and a half years.
cigars.researchNote: Sold under its own name, made by My Father Cigars. The maker calls it medium to full; Famous lists medium and Holt's lists full.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Decade; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: A stronger extension of the core My Father line, named for a judge who is a friend of the Garcia family. It uses three Nicaraguan fillers from the family's farms and a label taken from a 1905 lithograph.
cigars.researchNote: The maker's site shows the name as MF The Judge. Three of the four sizes are box-pressed; the Corona Gorda is not listed as pressed.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Bellas Artes; Arturo Fuente Opus X
cigars.about: A box-pressed extension of the core My Father line with a Mexican wrapper, named after an old Cuban trademark the Garcias revived. The label reworks artwork dating to 1897.
cigars.researchNote: Maker calls it medium to 3/4 body; halfwheel found medium-full; Famous and Holt's list full. The maker only says Mexican rosado oscuro for the wrapper; Holt's names it San Andres. Torpedo is 6 1/8 inches per the maker, 6 1/2 per halfwheel.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; CAO Pilón
cigars.about: A darker, fuller blend in the My Father family that Jose "Pepin" Garcia made in memory of his father, who was born in 1922. The name means The Jewel.
cigars.researchNote: Sources disagree on the wrapper: halfwheel lists a Nicaraguan Habano Oscuro wrapper, while Holt's says Ecuador Habano and Famous shows both. The maker only says Habano Oscuro.

cigars.about: A Honduran line sold wrapped in a raw tobacco leaf instead of cellophane. Pittsburgh retailer "Island" Jim Robinson created it with Oscar Valladares, who makes it at his factory in Danlí.
cigars.researchNote: This is the whole line. It comes in four wrappers (Connecticut, Corojo, Maduro, Sumatra) and strength depends on the wrapper. A Criollo 10th Anniversary version was added in 2023. The maker's site lists the lancero as 7 x 48; halfwheel and retailers list 7 x 38.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Vintage 1990; AVO Heritage
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown natural (also sold in Nicaraguan maduro)
cigars.about: The 2000 is the 5 x 50 robusto in the Padrón Series, the company's original core line of Nicaraguan puros. It comes in natural and maduro wrappers and is sold in boxes of 26.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the Padrón Series (often called the Thousand Series), not a separate blend. Strength sources differ: the maker calls the series medium to full bodied and Cigar Aficionado rates the 2000 Maduro Medium-Full, but Holt's lists the series as Medium.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Vintage 1990; AVO Heritage
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown natural (also sold in Nicaraguan maduro)
cigars.about: The 3000 is the 5 1/2 x 52 size in the Padrón Series, the company's original core line of Nicaraguan puros. It comes in natural and maduro wrappers and is sold in boxes of 26 and 4 packs.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the Padrón Series (Thousand Series), not a separate blend. The maker calls the series medium to full bodied, but Neptune and Holt's both list the 3000 as Medium. Cigar Aficionado files it as a toro and Neptune as a robusto, so no shape name is given.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo 20th Anniversary; Ashton ESG
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown natural (also sold in Nicaraguan maduro)
cigars.about: A box-pressed Nicaraguan puro that Padrón introduced in 1994 to mark the company's 30th anniversary, made with tobacco aged four years. The natural Torpedo was Cigar Aficionado's Cigar of the Year for 2021.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it a limited production series, but it is an ongoing regular line. Padron.com does not state strength or the blend; Medium-Full is from Holt's and Cigar Aficionado's rating of the natural Torpedo. Padron.com lists sixteen sizes; the ten most common are shown.

cigars.similarCigars: Dunbarton Mi Querida; La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown natural (also sold in Nicaraguan maduro)
cigars.about: A box-pressed Nicaraguan puro named for the birth year of founder José Orlando Padrón and made with tobacco aged five years. Cigar Aficionado describes it as a bit stronger than the 1964 Anniversary, and the No. 9 was its Cigar of the Year for 2007.
cigars.researchNote: The maker spells it 1926 Serie; Cigar Aficionado writes Serie 1926. Strength: the maker calls it full-bodied, while Cigar Aficionado rated the natural No. 2 Medium-Full. Padron.com says it premiered for José O. Padrón's 75th birthday; Cigar Aficionado says his 76th, a year later than planned.

cigars.similarCigars: La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero; Dunbarton Mi Querida
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan sun-grown natural (also sold in Nicaraguan maduro)
cigars.about: Padrón's top regular line, a Nicaraguan puro made with tobacco aged ten years and sold in boxes of ten. Each size is named for a company anniversary or a birthday of founder José Orlando Padrón, and the No. 45 Maduro was Cigar Aficionado's Cigar of the Year for 2009.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it full-bodied, but Cigar Aficionado's ratings vary: No. 45 Maduro Full, No. 45 Natural Medium-Full, 50 Years Maduro Medium-Full, 50 Years Natural Medium. Halfwheel calls the No. 44 a belicoso; Cigar Aficionado and retailers call it a torpedo.

cigars.otherWrapperVersions: Many 1845 variants incl. Cameroon, Broadleaf Maduro
cigars.similarCigars: Montecristo Classic; Ashton Cabinet Selection
cigars.about: A non-Cuban Partagas from General Cigar that broke from the brand's usual Cameroon wrapper when it launched in 2012. It was reblended and renamed 1845 Clásico in 2017, and the maker now lists it as retired.
cigars.researchNote: Blend shown is the 2017 Clásico reblend. The 2012 original used an Ecuadorian Habano Viso wrapper and Connecticut Habano binder, and the maker's site still lists that older blend. Neptune lists it as medium.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; CAO Flathead
cigars.about: A Cuban robusto from Habanos S.A. and the best known cigar in the Partagás Serie D range. Habanos rates the brand as full strength and blends it from Vuelta Abajo tobacco.
cigars.researchNote: This is one size (a 4 7/8 x 50 robusto) in the Cuban Partagás Serie D range, not a full line. It is the Cuban Partagás from Habanos S.A., a different product from the non-Cuban Partagas sold in the US. Habanos rates the brand full, while Cigar Aficionado has rated it medium. The 1975 release year comes from Wikipedia only.

cigars.similarCigars: Sancho Panza Double Maduro; CAO Flathead
cigars.about: The dark, full-bodied member of the non-Cuban Partagas family, built around a late-harvested Medio Tiempo wrapper and ligero-heavy Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. It is a current core line.
cigars.researchNote: The maker lists the wrapper as Connecticut Havana seed Medio Tiempo, while Holt's calls it Connecticut Broadleaf. The maker's text says full bodied but its body gauge reads medium to full. Famous, Holt's and Neptune all list it as full.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente Don Carlos; Ashton ESG
cigars.about: A non-Cuban Partagas from General Cigar that was sold in the mid-2000s, with sizes named after months of the year. Cigar Aficionado lists it as Dominican made with a Honduran wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler.
cigars.researchNote: Cigar Aficionado lists this as Partagas Cifuentes Blend and rated it from 2005 to 2007. The maker's site no longer lists it. Its tasting notes call two sizes a pressed maduro, but no leaf type is published. A separate 1990s cigar, Cifuentes by Partagas, was made in Jamaica with a Connecticut Shade wrapper.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Macassar; Ashton Cabinet Selection
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Three versions: Ecuadorian Connecticut, Nicaraguan Sun Grown or Nicaraguan Maduro
cigars.about: A Perdomo line made in Esteli in three wrapper versions over Nicaraguan binder and filler. The wrappers are aged at least six years and then finished for months in used bourbon barrels.
cigars.researchNote: Comes in three wrappers, so there is no single wrapper or strength. Perdomo rates the Connecticut mild to medium and the Sun Grown and Maduro medium to full.

cigars.similarCigars: Rocky Patel Sun Grown; Ashton ESG
cigars.about: A single-farm Nicaraguan puro from Perdomo, built on tobacco from one plot in Esteli that the family began developing in 2000. Cigar Journal named it Best Value Brand of Nicaragua in 2012.
cigars.researchNote: Perdomo now calls this version Lot 23 Natural Sun Grown. Holt's calls the wrapper Nicaraguan Corojo and Famous Smoke sells it as Habano; Perdomo says Nicaraguan Sun Grown. Launch year not confirmed, but it was on sale by October 2006. Connecticut and Maduro versions also exist.

cigars.similarCigars: Caldwell Eastern Standard; Rocky Patel Vintage 1999
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Three versions: Ecuadorian Connecticut, Nicaraguan Sun Grown or Nicaraguan Maduro
cigars.about: Perdomo's Reserve 10th Anniversary family started with the Connecticut-wrapped Champagne and later added box-pressed Sun Grown and Maduro versions. All use Nicaraguan binder and filler aged about six years and bourbon barrel-aged wrappers.
cigars.researchNote: Comes in three wrappers: Champagne (Ecuadorian Connecticut, mild to medium), Sun Grown and Maduro (both medium to full). The Champagne dates to 2004; the box-pressed Sun Grown and Maduro arrived in 2020. Sizes listed are the six shared by all three.

cigars.similarCigars: AVO Domaine; Ashton ESG
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Three versions: Ecuadorian Connecticut, Nicaraguan Sun Grown or Nicaraguan Maduro
cigars.about: Released for Perdomo's 20th year in business, with Nicaraguan binder and filler from the company's farms in Esteli, Condega and Jalapa. The wrappers are aged eight years and then finished in bourbon barrels.
cigars.researchNote: Comes in three wrappers. Sun Grown and Maduro launched in 2012 and are box-pressed, both medium to full. The Connecticut was added in 2016, is round, and is mild to medium. Perdomo now says the wrappers are 8 years old; the 2012 launch release said over 6.

cigars.similarCigars: CAO Brazilia; Cohiba Black
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Three versions: Ecuadorian Connecticut, Nicaraguan Sun Grown or Nicaraguan Maduro
cigars.about: A Perdomo line built on 12-year-old tobacco: bale-aged for ten years, then aged two more years in charred white oak bourbon barrels. It is sold in Connecticut, Sun Grown and Maduro versions.
cigars.researchNote: Comes in three wrappers, so there is no single wrapper or strength. Perdomo rates the Connecticut mild to medium and the Sun Grown and Maduro medium to full. Halfwheel lists the Salomon as 6 1/8 x 50/60. The 2014 debut was a limited run of 2,500 boxes per size.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente 8-5-8; Kristoff Criollo
cigars.about: The Plasencia family's earlier organic cigar, a Nicaraguan puro made entirely from organically grown tobacco under a dark maduro wrapper. It predates the family's current organic line, Reserva Original.
cigars.researchNote: Brand is spelled Plasencia. Neptune lists it as discontinued and the maker's site no longer shows it; the current organic line is Reserva Original, launched in 2017. Only the Churchill size could be confirmed.

cigars.similarCigars: La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero; Padron Family Reserve
cigars.about: The first cigar in Plasencia's Alma series, a Nicaraguan puro made with aged tobacco from the family's own farms. It is known for its hexagon-pressed Sixto II and its large Salomon.
cigars.researchNote: Brand is spelled Plasencia. The maker now labels this original blend Alma Fuerte Oscuro, to tell it apart from the lighter Alma Fuerte Colorado Claro. Maker rates strength 4 of 5; Famous Smoke calls it full-bodied.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez Dias de Gloria; Arturo Fuente Hemingway Short Story
cigars.about: A Honduran-made Punch from General Cigar with a reddish Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper. It was sold as a seasonal limited release from 2001 until it became a year-round line in January 2025.
cigars.researchNote: Despite the name, the wrapper is Ecuadorian Sumatra, not Corojo. Holt's rates it medium-full, Neptune rates it full. It was a limited seasonal release until 2025.

cigars.similarCigars: AJ Fernandez San Lotano Oval; CAO Pilón
cigars.about: An all-Honduran Punch from General Cigar, introduced in 2003. It uses a sun-grown Havana-seed wrapper over Honduran binder and filler.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's and Famous rate it medium-full, Neptune rates it medium. Famous lists the Sesenta as 6 x 60. A separate Gran Puro Nicaragua line with a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper was added in 2017.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Connecticut; EP Carrillo New Wave Connecticut
cigars.about: A mild line that Neptune Cigar lists simply as the Connecticut by Rocky Patel, with no stock shown. It is listed separately from the Vintage 1999 Connecticut and The Edge Connecticut.
cigars.researchNote: Only a retailer listing with no stock and no blend details could be confirmed, so wrapper, binder and filler are left blank. The maker's site does not list it. Do not confuse it with the Vintage 1999 Connecticut or The Edge Connecticut.

cigars.similarCigars: Macanudo Inspirado Black; Foundation Wise Man Maduro
cigars.about: A box-pressed Honduran cigar with a 12-year-old Honduran broadleaf wrapper. The Vintage series was the first to carry the Rocky Patel name, and the maker describes this one as medium-bodied leaning mild.
cigars.researchNote: The maker now calls it Vintage 1990 Broadleaf. Cigar Aficionado lists a Nicaraguan binder, while Neptune lists a Honduran binder.

cigars.similarCigars: Montecristo Classic; Caldwell Eastern Standard
cigars.about: The mild member of the Vintage series, built around an aged Connecticut shade wrapper from the 1999 crop. It is made in Honduras with Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls it Vintage 1999 Connecticut. halfwheel lists a Nicaraguan binder, while Neptune and Developing Palates list Honduran. Also sold in 5 x 50 and 7 x 48 glass tubes.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo Lot 23; Padron 3000
cigars.wrapperLeaf: Ecuadorian Sumatra, sun grown, aged 5 years
cigars.about: A Honduran-made Rocky Patel with a five-year-old Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper grown in full sun. The maker describes it as medium-plus in body.
cigars.researchNote: The maker publishes only the wrapper. The filler shown is what Famous Smoke and Holt's list. Both rate it Full, stronger than the maker's medium-plus. The Sun Grown Maduro is a separate Nicaraguan-made line.

cigars.similarCigars: J.C. Newman Diamond Crown; Caldwell Eastern Standard
cigars.about: A Honduran-made Rocky Patel with an Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper. The blend was developed by combining tobaccos used in the Vintage 1990 and Vintage 1992.
cigars.researchNote: Blend details come from a single retailer listing that shows no stock. The maker's site does not list it, so it may be hard to find.

cigars.similarCigars: CAO Amazon Basin; La Gloria Cubana Medio Tiempo
cigars.about: A Nicaraguan-made blend with an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper and two binders, one Connecticut broadleaf and one Connecticut shade. It was Cigar Aficionado's No. 5 cigar of 2014 with a 94 rating.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls the wrapper Ecuadorian Sumatra, while Cigar Aficionado calls it Havana-seed leaf from Ecuador. Neptune lists Full strength. Most sizes are box-pressed, but the Sixty, Colossal and Toro Tubo are round. The maker's online portfolio no longer listed Royale in early 2026, so check availability.

cigars.similarCigars: EP Carrillo Inch; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: A box-pressed Honduran cigar made to mark Rocky Patel's tenth year in the business, introduced at the 2007 trade show. It earned a 95 rating from Cigar Aficionado.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls the binder and filler a secret blend and names only the Sumatra wrapper. Cigar Aficionado and halfwheel list Nicaraguan binder and filler. Retailers call it Full, while halfwheel's review put it at medium-full.

cigars.similarCigars: La Flor Dominicana Ligero Cabinet; Padron Family Reserve
cigars.about: The Edge is Rocky Patel's value line, launched in 2004 and originally sold unbanded in boxes of 100. This is the original Corojo version, made in Honduras at Plasencia's El Paraiso factory.
cigars.researchNote: The Edge is a family of blends named by wrapper. This entry covers the original Corojo. The Maduro, Connecticut, Sumatra and Habano are separate blends. Famous Smoke lists it as Full, while Neptune's spec sheet says Medium.

cigars.similarCigars: Arturo Fuente Curly Head; Baccarat Original
cigars.about: The Connecticut-wrapped Romeo y Julieta from Altadis U.S.A., made in the Dominican Republic with Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. It is positioned as a creamier, smoother smoke than the classic 1875.
cigars.researchNote: This is the non-Cuban Romeo y Julieta made by Altadis U.S.A. Holt's and Neptune list Medium; Atlantic lists most sizes Mild-Medium. Barberpole Twisted versions and a separate Reserva Real Nicaragua line also exist.

cigars.similarCigars: Perdomo Lot 23; AVO Heritage
cigars.about: The classic Dominican-made Romeo y Julieta from Altadis U.S.A., with an Indonesian shade-grown wrapper over Dominican binder and filler. It is a smooth, mellow cigar known for its white ash and wide range of sizes.
cigars.researchNote: 1875 is the year the brand was founded, not this line's launch year. Altadis calls it medium-bodied; Holt's lists Mild-Medium and Neptune Mild. The wrapper is Indonesian shade leaf, so the category is the nearest fit. Not the same as the Honduran-made 1875 by Romeo y Julieta.

cigars.similarCigars: Caldwell Eastern Standard; Rocky Patel Vintage 1999
cigars.about: A mild, creamy Dominican Romeo y Julieta with an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper, Mexican binder and aged Dominican filler. Altadis positions it as the special-occasion cigar of the range.
cigars.researchNote: Holt's lists Mild-Medium and Neptune lists Mild. Altadis still lists the line, but several sizes show as sold out or discontinued at retailers, so stock may be thin.

cigars.similarCigars: La Gloria Cubana Original; Rocky Patel Sun Grown
cigars.about: A Honduran-made Romeo y Julieta with a dark Nicaraguan wrapper and binder over Honduran and Nicaraguan filler. It is one of the fuller cigars under the Romeo y Julieta name.
cigars.researchNote: Altadis now lists this blend simply as Romeo y Julieta Reserve; the blend, sizes and Honduran factory match, and Neptune and Atlantic still use the Habana Reserve name. Neptune's table says Medium but its text says medium to full. No source names the wrapper seed; the category follows the Colorado Maduro color Neptune lists.

cigars.similarCigars: Cohiba Black; Ashton VSG
cigars.about: One of three non-Cuban Sancho Panza lines General Cigar reblended and repackaged in 2022 with Matt Booth of Room101. It is made in Honduras with a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper.
cigars.researchNote: Details are for the 2022 blend; older Double Maduro boxes were a different blend. Despite the name, the wrapper is Ecuadorian Sumatra. General calls it medium-plus. STG removed Sancho Panza from its price lists in January 2026 and has not said what happens to the brand.

cigars.wrapperLeaf: Maduro (leaf type and origin not published)
cigars.about: A house cigar from Stanley Pappas Cigars, the Denver-area cigar shop and lounge. The shop describes it as a full-bodied maduro with nut and chocolate notes, sold in boxes of 20.
cigars.researchNote: The only source is the shop's own site, which does not publish binder, filler, country, factory or strength. Maduro is read from its line calling this a full body cigar for a maduro smoker, so check the box. Georgios, Stavros, Evgenios and Theodoros share one description, so may be one blend in four sizes; the site does not say.

cigars.about: A house cigar from Stanley Pappas Cigars, the Denver-area cigar shop and lounge. It is a mild to medium smoke with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan and Honduran tobaccos, sold in boxes of 20.
cigars.researchNote: The only source is the shop's own site, which does not publish the country or factory. Steely, Kostaki, Ioannis and Lady Victoria share the same blend and description, which suggests one Connecticut blend in four sizes, though the site does not say so. Listed as out of stock on the shop's site when checked in October 2026.

cigars.about: A house cigar from Stanley Pappas Cigars, the Denver-area cigar shop and lounge. It is a mild to medium smoke with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan and Honduran tobaccos, sold in boxes of 20.
cigars.researchNote: The only source is the shop's own site, which does not publish the country or factory. Steely, Kostaki, Ioannis and Lady Victoria share the same blend and description, which suggests one Connecticut blend in four sizes, though the site does not say so. Listed as out of stock on the shop's site when checked in October 2026.

cigars.about: A house cigar from Stanley Pappas Cigars, the Denver-area cigar shop and lounge. It is a mild to medium smoke with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan and Honduran tobaccos, sold in boxes of 20.
cigars.researchNote: The only source is the shop's own site, which does not publish the country or factory. Steely, Kostaki, Ioannis and Lady Victoria share the same blend and description, which suggests one Connecticut blend in four sizes, though the site does not say so.

cigars.about: A house cigar from Stanley Pappas Cigars, the Denver-area cigar shop and lounge. It is a mild to medium smoke with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan and Honduran tobaccos, sold in boxes of 20.
cigars.researchNote: The only source is the shop's own site, which does not publish the country or factory. Steely, Kostaki, Ioannis and Lady Victoria share the same blend and description, which suggests one Connecticut blend in four sizes, though the site does not say so.

cigars.about: A mellow Connecticut-wrapped cigar made in Honduras by Plasencia, using tobaccos said to be aged five years.
cigars.researchNote: Retailers split on strength: Neptune lists Medium, Mike's Cigars and CigarsDirect list Mild to Medium. Sources name Plasencia as the maker but not a specific factory.

cigars.about: The original 5 Vegas blend, a medium-strength cigar made in Nicaragua with a Sumatra wrapper over Nicaraguan and Dominican tobaccos.
cigars.researchNote: Holts sells this simply as 5 Vegas. Sources do not say where the Sumatra wrapper is grown. Holts and Neptune list Dominican and Nicaraguan filler, while CigarsDirect lists all Nicaraguan. Neptune names Plasencia as the maker.

cigars.about: A darker 5 Vegas line with a Costa Rican maduro wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder and filler from three countries. It smokes medium to full with notes of dark chocolate and earth.
cigars.researchNote: Neptune's spec table rates it Medium, while its description, CigarsDirect and Stogie Review say medium to full. Neptune lists Nicaragua as the origin; an older Stogie Review guest review said Honduras. More sizes exist than the two listed here. On sale by 2006.

cigars.about: A full-bodied 5 Vegas blend built on Nicaraguan ligero filler under a triple-fermented Pennsylvania Broadleaf maduro wrapper. It is also written as AAA.
cigars.researchNote: Also sold as 5 Vegas AAA. Neptune's spec table says Connecticut Broadleaf, but its line description and Blind Man's Puff say Pennsylvania Broadleaf. Factory disagrees: Blind Man's Puff credits AJ Fernandez (Tabacalera Fernandez) on the AAA lancero, Neptune lists Plasencia.

cigars.about: A full-bodied 5 Vegas line made in the United States with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over Nicaraguan tobaccos. The 2014 version was blended by George Rico.
cigars.researchNote: Blend and factory are for the 2014 version by George Rico, per Blind Man's Puff. That review calls it the 2014 version, so older 5 Vegas Miami cigars may be a different blend. Blind Man's Puff rated the 2014 Toro medium in strength, while Neptune lists Full.

cigars.about: A semi box-pressed Nicaraguan cigar from Espinosa with a dark Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. Espinosa describes it as a mix of sweetness and spice.
cigars.researchNote: Espinosa calls it 601 Blue Maduro. The 601 brand debuted in 2006 with blends made by Pepin Garcia; Espinosa took it over in 2012. Neptune lists La Zona as the maker, but the 2026 Blue 20th Anniversary is made at AJ Fernandez's San Lotano factory, so the factory for current boxes may differ.

cigars.about: The Habano-wrapped 601 from Espinosa, with Nicaraguan binder and filler. It placed number 14 on Cigar Aficionado's Top 25 list for 2017.
cigars.researchNote: Espinosa lists an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, while Neptune and CigarsDirect list a Nicaraguan wrapper. Neptune rates it Full, CigarsDirect medium-full. Factory disagrees: Neptune lists La Zona, CigarsDirect says AJ Fernandez now makes it at San Lotano.

cigars.about: An all-Nicaraguan cigar from Espinosa with a thick, dark oscuro wrapper. Espinosa calls it the fullest-bodied blend in the 601 range and not one for new smokers.
cigars.researchNote: Espinosa calls it 601 Green Oscuro and lists the wrapper only as Nicaraguan. Retailers describe it as Habano Oscuro. CigarsDirect rates it medium-full, below the maker's own description. Some recent 601 releases are made at AJ Fernandez's San Lotano factory rather than La Zona.

cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro from Espinosa with a habano wrapper and a long pigtail cap styled as a bomb fuse. It is sold as a very strong, spicy cigar for experienced smokers.
cigars.researchNote: The Sake Bomb size uses a tweaked, stronger filler. The Warhead releases are separate limited editions, and recent ones are made at AJ Fernandez's San Lotano factory.

cigars.about: A 5 x 54 infused robusto from Drew Estate's ACID Blue line and one of the best-selling ACID cigars. It is mild, sweet and very aromatic.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the ACID Blue line. Larger versions are Kuba Deluxe (6 x 50) and Kuba Grande (6 x 60). Drew Estate does not publish the blend or the infusion; the Sumatra wrapper comes from retailers. CigarsDirect rates it mild to medium.

cigars.about: A small 4 x 38 infused cigar from Drew Estate's ACID Blue line with a Connecticut wrapper. It is one of the mainstay ACID cigars.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the ACID Blue line. Blondie Belicoso (5 x 54), Blondie Maduro, Candela, Gold and Red are separate versions. Drew Estate does not publish the blend or infusion. Neptune lists the wrapper as U.S. Connecticut Shade; halfwheel only says Connecticut.

cigars.about: A maduro-wrapped infused toro from Drew Estate and the first ACID Subculture blend sold nationwide. It is known for sweetness with cinnamon and nutmeg notes.
cigars.researchNote: Part of ACID Subculture, not ACID Blue. Retailers list it at 6 x 50, while a halfwheel news item lists 6 x 52. Drew Estate does not publish the blend; wrapper and binder come from Neptune. CigarsDirect rates it mild to medium.

cigars.about: A slim 6 3/4 x 44 infused cigar from Drew Estate's ACID Gold line with a Connecticut Shade wrapper. Some retailers sell it as Cold Infusion Tea.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the ACID Gold line, which retailers also call ACID Yellow or Holistics. Drew Estate does not publish the blend or infusion. Neptune lists the wrapper as U.S. Connecticut Shade. CigarsDirect rates it mild to medium. Drew Estate lists 6 3/4 x 44, while a halfwheel news item lists 7 x 44.

cigars.about: The maduro version of ACID Kuba Kuba, a 5 x 54 infused robusto from Drew Estate's ACID Blue line. It pairs the same sweet infusion with a dark broadleaf wrapper.
cigars.researchNote: Drew Estate lists it as Kuba Kuba Maduro; halfwheel and some retailers shorten it to Kuba Maduro. One size in the ACID Blue line. Drew Estate does not publish the blend; the wrapper comes from retailers. CigarsDirect rates it mild to medium.

cigars.about: A 5 x 50 infused robusto from Drew Estate's ACID Blue line that comes packed in a glass tube. It has a Connecticut Shade wrapper and a mild, sweet profile.
cigars.researchNote: One size in the ACID Blue line. Drew Estate does not publish the blend or infusion. Neptune and CigarsDirect list a U.S. Connecticut Shade wrapper. Neptune rates it mild, CigarsDirect medium.

cigars.about: A Connecticut-wrapped follow-up to ACID 20, the infused cigar Drew Estate made for the brand's 20th anniversary. It has a sweetened cap and comes in a single toro size.
cigars.researchNote: Size disagrees: Drew Estate and Mike's Cigars list the Toro at 6 x 50, while halfwheel and Neptune list 6 x 54. Halfwheel gives an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper, Neptune lists U.S. Connecticut Shade. Retailers rate it medium, though halfwheel's reviewer found almost no nicotine strength. The infusion is not disclosed.

cigars.filler: Nicaragua (Estelí and Jalapa, Corojo 99 and Criollo 98 with medio tiempo)
cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro made entirely from Aganorsa's own farm tobacco, with a Corojo 99 wrapper and a little rare medio tiempo leaf in the filler. It was the first new line after Casa Fernandez renamed itself Aganorsa Leaf in 2018.
cigars.researchNote: The maker now lists it as Signature Corojo and ships it in small allotments a few times a year. Maker and Neptune rate it medium; halfwheel's review found it medium-full in strength with a full body.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: The maduro follow-up to Signature Selection, keeping the same Nicaraguan binder and filler but using a shade-grown Corojo 99 wrapper from Jalapa that is fermented dark. It is a Nicaraguan puro from Aganorsa's own farms.
cigars.researchNote: Also sold as Signature Selection Maduro. The maduro wrapper is Nicaraguan corojo, not broadleaf or San Andrés. The maker's page lists the Corona Gorda at 6 x 46; halfwheel and Neptune list 6 x 44. Halfwheel's review found it builds to full strength by the end.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: A Criollo 98 focused Nicaraguan puro from Aganorsa, built from small lots of leaf off the company's best farms. It is a regular production cigar sold only through Aganorsa Select retailers.
cigars.researchNote: The maker calls this version Rare Leaf Corojo and lists the wrapper only as Nicaragua Café; Corona Cigar lists Corojo 99. Launch materials gave a double Criollo 98 binder, but the maker's page now lists Corojo 99. Strength is from the maker's 4.5 of 5 graphic; Neptune lists medium. Halfwheel lists the Robusto at 5 1/4 x 52.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: The San Andrés wrapped follow-up to Rare Leaf Reserve, with a double Nicaraguan binder and Aganorsa filler from Estelí and Jalapa. Like the original, it is sold only through Aganorsa Select retailers.
cigars.researchNote: Maker and Neptune rate it full; halfwheel's review found it closer to medium-plus strength with a medium body. Halfwheel calls the 6 x 52 a Belicoso and lists the Robusto at 5 1/4 x 52.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: A Corojo 99 dominant Nicaraguan puro from Aganorsa, known for its bright, colorful bands. It comes out in batches about twice a year, each time in a different size.
cigars.researchNote: Not a true limited edition, but each size ships in small batches and sells out, so what is on the shelf changes. The full blend is not published beyond being Corojo 99 dominant. The maker's strength graphic sits between medium and medium-full; Neptune lists medium.

cigars.about: Aganorsa's core Connecticut cigar, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper over Aganorsa-grown Nicaraguan binder and filler. It is one of the four blends in the company's La Validación series.
cigars.researchNote: Formerly Casa Fernandez Aganorsa Connecticut, renamed Aganorsa Leaf Connecticut in 2018 and repackaged in 2022 as La Validación Connecticut. Aganorsa also sells a separate Aniversario Connecticut. Halfwheel lists the Toro at 6 1/4 x 52.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro created by Max Fernandez of Aganorsa and Kyle Gellis of Warped Cigars, named for the American bulldogs that guard Aganorsa's farms and factory. Each size is named after one of the dogs.
cigars.researchNote: Launched as a Warped and Casa Fernandez collaboration. The maduro version is sold as Guardian of the Farm NightWatch, and Cerberus is a separate Corojo 2012 wrapped blend. Halfwheel's review put the body a little above medium.

cigars.factory: Aganorsa (formerly Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A., TABSA), Estelí
cigars.about: The oversized, value-priced branch of Aganorsa's JFR (Just For Retailers) brand, with ring gauges running up to 80 and beyond. It started with the 8 x 80 Mambo in a San Andrés maduro wrapper.
cigars.researchNote: Lunatic is a family. Details here are the original Lunatic Maduro. Lunatic Habano uses an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over the same Nicaraguan binder and filler; Lunatic Locos and Lunatic Torch are separate corojo wrapped blends. The maker's strength graphic sits between medium and medium-full; Neptune lists the Maduro as full.

cigars.about: A value-priced Nicaraguan puro from Aganorsa's JFR (Just For Retailers) brand, with a corojo wrapper, a tucked foot and a pigtail cap. The JFR brand is known for large ring gauges.
cigars.researchNote: JFR stands for Just For Retailers and was built for brick-and-mortar shops. Neptune's write-up calls it full-bodied while listing its strength as medium.

cigars.about: The maduro version of Aganorsa's value-priced JFR (Just For Retailers) line, finished with a tucked foot and a pigtail cap. It is the stronger of the two main JFR blends.
cigars.researchNote: Sources disagree on the wrapper: the maker's site lists Mexican San Andrés Maduro, while halfwheel (2022) and Neptune describe a Nicaraguan puro with a fermented corojo maduro wrapper. Strength is from the maker's 4 of 5 graphic; Neptune lists medium.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.about: A box-pressed Nicaraguan puro blended by Rafael Nodal and made by AJ Fernandez in Estelí. The Maestro size was Cigar Aficionado's No. 1 Cigar of 2019 with a 96 rating.
cigars.researchNote: Altadis lists the wrapper as Nicaraguan Sumatra; halfwheel and Cigar Aficionado only say Nicaragua. Strength is Neptune's rating, as Altadis does not give one. Quattro Nicaragua Sonata and Concerto are separate, later blends.

cigars.about: The original box-pressed Aging Room Quattro, made by Jochy Blanco at Tabacalera Palma with an aged Sumatra wrapper grown in Indonesia over Dominican tobacco. As the Quattro F55 Concerto it was Cigar Aficionado's No. 2 cigar of 2013.
cigars.researchNote: Formerly called Quattro F55; renamed Quattro Original in 2018. Cigar Aficionado rates it medium-full while Neptune lists full. It is no longer on Altadis USA's Aging Room page and Neptune shows it sold out, so current availability is unclear.

cigars.about: The mildest of the box-pressed Aging Room Quattro blends, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper over Dominican binder and filler. It was added to the Quattro series in 2018 and made at Tabacalera Palma.
cigars.researchNote: Neptune marks every size discontinued and it is no longer on Altadis USA's Aging Room page. Strength is Neptune's rating; no maker rating was found.

cigars.about: The Quattro Original blend with a Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper in place of the Sumatra leaf. It began in 2017 as a Thompson exclusive called Quattro F55M before going national.
cigars.researchNote: Formerly Quattro F55M (F55 Maduro); renamed Quattro Maduro in 2018. Neptune marks every size discontinued and it is no longer on Altadis USA's Aging Room page. Strength is Neptune's rating; halfwheel's 2017 review found it medium-plus in strength with a medium body.

cigars.about: A Nicaraguan puro from Rafael Nodal made by the Plasencia family, using tobacco from four Nicaraguan growing regions. The name means pure bred in Spanish.
cigars.researchNote: Launched as Aging Room Small Batch Pura Cepa. Neptune calls the wrapper Nicaraguan Habano; halfwheel only says Nicaragua. Strength is Neptune's rating; halfwheel's reviewer did not find it especially strong. It is no longer on Altadis USA's Aging Room page, so current availability is unclear.

cigars.factory: Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A.
cigars.about: A small-run Nicaraguan puro from Rafael Nodal and AJ Fernandez built around rare, well-aged tobaccos, including some pelo de oro. The wrapper is a Cuban-seed hybrid grown on Fernandez's La Lilia farm.
cigars.researchNote: Billed as a series of small runs that depend on available tobacco; this is the first release. Neptune now marks all sizes discontinued.
